doNotDo: Do NOT edit any frozen artifact in place — governed change package + new baseline version only
Do NOT record any GitHub step as passing unless the owner actually executed it and returned output
Do NOT write anything to the baseline after generating a freeze manifest (F-R7-02)
Do NOT proceed past Step 112 without explicit owner authorization for Step 113
Do NOT treat the 360/360 verification figure as independently verified (OD-05)
Do NOT infer approval from silence
Do NOT add a third-party app to required status checks — an external service must never block or unblock a merge
Do NOT leave required-check source as 'Any source' — it permits forgeable check results
Do NOT describe human-review independence on this repo as enforced; it is attested
Do NOT use browser file upload for multi-file or nested commits — it silently loses dot-files, caps at 100, and discards directory structure. Use GitHub Desktop.
Do NOT write a check that skips-and-passes when its target is missing — distinguish absent-expected from absent-unexpected
Do NOT use an MI-only SQL Server capability while OQ-13 remains open — it silently closes an intentionally open decision
Do NOT record Fabric as simply 'excluded' — the exclusion is deployment-target only; it remains valid as a data source
Do NOT mark the Implementation Guide complete without checking the forward requirements register
Do NOT introduce a migration framework — it works against P-8 (see FR-007)
Do NOT rely on Python 3.13 free-threaded mode — experimental, and AC-MINING-PLACEMENT already removes the need (see FR-008)
Do NOT use any tool not listed ACTIVE in the technology registry — unlisted is DENIED by default
Do NOT diagnose repository state from a branch — compare against main first (AE-01)
Do NOT assume a commit was pushed; commit and push are separate actions in GitHub Desktop
Do NOT skip pulling after a merge — a stale local clone caused a 45-minute failure sequence
Do NOT rely on a governance check without negative-testing it; F-R10-01 passed a real secret
Do NOT trust a governance check that has never been negative-tested — three separate checks were found this session passing without examining anything
Do NOT run pip-audit against a global Python install and read the result as a project finding — use the locked environment
